role: Generated biome registry: a static const table of the 1.7.10 BiomeGenBase objects (name, class, temperature category, heights, temperature, rainfall, top/filler blocks, surface builder kind, lightning/snow flags). Written by netherite.oracle.BiomeTable via make -C oracle biomes-h; never edited by hand.

structs.name: biome_def
structs.java: BiomeGenBase instance fields as read from the live biome objects

structs.name: surface_kind
structs.java: which subclass override of func_150573_a (surface genTerrainBlocks) runs

notes: Read-only constant data; each translation unit gets its own static copy, which is harmless on the CPU and maps to constant memory on the GPU. Read by layers.c, surface.c, terrain.c, populate.c, features_lakes.c, stronghold.c (worldgen) and by servertick.c, fire.c and ai.c (weather, snow and lightning checks inside the tick). The Java member names listed are the fields BiomeTable reads; the exact reflection list in BiomeTable.java was not re-verified. Spawn lists and decorators are not in this table.
